# Tweet thread

1/ GitHub bills every Actions job rounded up to a whole minute. Across 1699 public repos (56,682 sampled jobs), 7.5 % of billed minutes were never executed. Median repo: 21.7 % of its bill is rounding. I built a CLI that shows you yours.

2/ ciburn reads .github/workflows, pulls your run/job/step history into SQLite, and attaches observed minutes + money to every finding, with the estimate method printed next to it. 2026 rates. No LLM, no service. `uv tool install .` then `ciburn audit`.

3/ Same dataset: 71.8 % of repos cache deps, 3.1 % set a timeout on every job, 132 of 776 with schedules have a cron failing 3+ times in a row. Dataset + method: https://github.com/addiiiooo/ciburn
